title: 7 Best Thunkable Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Thunkable alternatives ranked for builders who want more than one live app, a real backend, and subscriptions without upgrading to a $99 plan. Blink, Adalo, FlutterFlow, Rork, Draftbit, Glide, Replit.
body_markdown:
Blink, for anyone who wants a managed backend, subscriptions, and code they own, from one prompt.


The Builder plan allows one live published app. Unlimited live apps require the Advanced plan, at $99/mo billed yearly.


Per Thunkable's FAQ, private projects go to read-only mode, and published apps become unavailable to end users on affected plans. Blink's code lives in your own GitHub repo.


It mostly connects to outside sources like Firebase, Airtable, or Google Sheets. Blink provisions a managed SQL database with sign-in from the prompt.
